_note: PUT this to /v2/acts/{actorId} as a pricingInfos array entry. PAY_PER_EVENT only on BRONZE. startedAt must be 14+ days out. Apify auto-adds 20% margin. Document combined cost in README.

macro_watch.eventDescription: One scored economic event that cleared the noise gate but carries a lower edge. Includes the event, currency, forecast vs previous, time, and any attached trader sentiment or prediction-market odds.

macro_elevated.eventDescription: One high-impact event, or any event with an edge score of 42 or higher. Includes the catalyst plus the trader bull/bear lean on the affected symbols and the related prediction-market odds.

macro_high_conviction.eventDescription: One high-impact event with an edge score of 60 or higher AND a strong trader lean or a strong prediction-market move. The clearest setups. Includes full trader sentiment and prediction-market detail. First 3 high conviction events per run are free so you can validate output.
